results.prompt: Explain how Word of Command works under the current rules, then compare its complete Oracle text with the selected printed wording. Do not silently truncate either text.
results.response:
Question type: printedVsOracle

Verdict: Current Oracle text governs under CR 108.1: the printed "may not be countered" clause is gone from the Oracle wording, "you make all the decisions it calls for" has been replaced by your actually controlling the player until the spell finishes resolving, and the Oracle text adds mana-ability restrictions that appear nowhere on the printed card.

Missing: Two evidentiary gaps, neither of which changes the verdict on the text comparison. (1) The decision document decision.Word-of-Command.0.257 has an empty `claims` array, so its per-claim supporting references could not be read; only its `resolution` and its supporting-rule reference were retrievable. (2) The corpus holds only 16 Comprehensive Rules paragraphs and none of them covers controlling another player, so the mechanics of player control here rest on the Oracle text plus the card's rulings — I could not cite a rule number for it.

Why: The card document card.e8ad3a77-b293-4d69-b080-27ca9f95d443 carries complete current Oracle text (currentAsOf 2026-09-18, sourced to the Scryfall 2026-09-18 bulk export) and is the authority for how the card works now. The verified test case case.pvo-2ED-Word-of-Command selects the Unlimited Edition printing as the printed wording to compare against, and a reviewed printedVsOracle decision for this card exists, so that decision is preferred here. The comparison is a full replacement: the printed forced-play wording and its uncounterability clause are absent from Oracle, while Oracle adds the control-of-player language and the mana-ability restrictions.

Governing authority: Current Oracle text of Word of Command, under CR 108.1 ("Use the Oracle card reference when determining a card's wording"), reinforced by the verified case case.pvo-2ED-Word-of-Command and the reviewed decision decision.Word-of-Command.0.257.

Quote [Current Oracle text — Word of Command, card.e8ad3a77-b293-4d69-b080-27ca9f95d443, currentAsOf 2026-09-18]: Look at target opponent's hand and choose a card from it. You control that player until Word of Command finishes resolving. The player plays that card if able. While doing so, the player can activate mana abilities only if they're from lands that player controls and only if mana they produce is spent to activate other mana abilities of lands the player controls and/or to play that card. If the chosen card is cast as a spell, you control the player while that spell is resolving.

Quote [Printed wording — Unlimited Edition (2ED), printing.239c8547-207b-41d1-a2be-8825bfc6ef7f; the selected printing per case.pvo-2ED-Word-of-Command]: You may look at opponent's hand and choose any card opponent can legally play using mana from his or her mana pool or lands. Opponent must play this card immediately; you make all the decisions it calls for. This spell may not be countered after you have looked at opponent's hand.

Quote [Printed wording — Limited Edition Alpha (LEA), printing.96c21429-98d3-416b-be00-6aa9c4c5a006 and Limited Edition Beta (LEB), printing.7d37b529-8a41-4177-abef-614f363e69d1; both carry the identical text below]: You may look at opponent's hand and choose any card opponent can legally play using mana from his or her mana pool or lands. Opponent must play this card immediately; you make all the decisions it calls for. This spell may not be countered after you have looked at opponent's hand.

Quote [CR 108.1, rule.108.1.2026-09-25]: Use the Oracle card reference when determining a card's wording. A card's Oracle text can be found using the Gatherer card database at Gatherer.Wizards.com.

Quote [CR 101.1, rule.101.1.2026-09-25]: Whenever a card's text directly contradicts these rules, the card takes precedence. The card overrides only the rule that applies to that specific situation. The only exception is that a player can concede the game at any time (see rule 104.3a).

Quote [Ruling 2004-10-04 on Word of Command]: To "play a card" is to either cast a spell or to put a land onto the battlefield using the main phase special action.

Quote [Ruling 2011-01-01, "During the resolution of this spell, that player plays the chosen card."]: During the resolution of this spell, that player plays the chosen card.

Quote [Ruling 2011-01-01, "Word of Command can't be used to force a player to play a card that isn't in their hand."]: Word of Command can't be used to force a player to play a card that isn't in their hand.

Quote [Ruling 2011-01-01, "You must order your opponent to play the chosen card if it is possible to do so."]: You must order your opponent to play the chosen card if it is possible to do so.

Quote [Ruling 2016-07-13, "Controlling a player doesn't allow you to look at that player's sideboard..."]: Controlling a player doesn't allow you to look at that player's sideboard. If an effect instructs that player to choose a card from outside the game, you can't have that player choose any card.

Rules: 108.1, 101.1

Conflict: The 2ED printed text and the current Oracle text disagree on three points — printed allows choosing only a card the opponent can legally play with mana from pool/lands (Oracle allows choosing any card in hand and then requires the player to play it if able), printed says you make all decisions the card calls for (Oracle gives you control of the player instead), printed says the spell may not be countered after you look (Oracle has no such clause), and Oracle adds mana-ability restrictions absent from the print. CR 108.1 makes the Oracle wording win, and case.pvo-2ED-Word-of-Command's expected verdict and decision.Word-of-Command.0.257 both resolve it that way. No conflict exists between the three printings themselves: LEA, LEB and 2ED carry identical text.

Sources: card.e8ad3a77-b293-4d69-b080-27ca9f95d443, printing.239c8547-207b-41d1-a2be-8825bfc6ef7f, printing.96c21429-98d3-416b-be00-6aa9c4c5a006, printing.7d37b529-8a41-4177-abef-614f363e69d1, diff.printing.239c8547-207b-41d1-a2be-8825bfc6ef7f, diff.printing.96c21429-98d3-416b-be00-6aa9c4c5a006, diff.printing.7d37b529-8a41-4177-abef-614f363e69d1, decision.Word-of-Command.0.257, rule.108.1.2026-08-07, rule.108.1.2026-09-25, rule.101.1.2026-08-07, rule.101.1.2026-09-25, rule.608.2.2026-09-25, case.pvo-2ED-Word-of-Command, case.rv-Word-of-Command, glossary.Oracle, claim.legality.e8ad3a77-b293-4d69-b080-27ca9f95d443.commander, claim.legality.e8ad3a77-b293-4d69-b080-27ca9f95d443.duel, claim.legality.e8ad3a77-b293-4d69-b080-27ca9f95d443.legacy, claim.legality.e8ad3a77-b293-4d69-b080-27ca9f95d443.oathbreaker, claim.legality.e8ad3a77-b293-4d69-b080-27ca9f95d443.vintage, source.scryfall.2026-09-18, source.cr.2026-09-25, source.mtgjson
